ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by approximately 25-30% high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal lobe tips and 70-75% low-intensity black pixels across the central and proximal regions.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous white patches occupy the outer third of the right lobe and the upper outer quadrant of the left lobe. The central axis from the peduncle to the median notch is solid black, with irregular mottling at the transition zones between black and white pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an estimated internal angle of 45-50 degrees; depth is significant with shadow occlusion at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations present along the entire trailing boundary. A notable deep concave indentation (notch) is visible on the inner trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex leading edges curving upward toward the tips, with a jagged concave sweep returning toward the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of textured, high-contrast brownish-white pixel groups (barnacle colonies) are localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation on the distal lobe tips; irregular trailing edge geometry suggesting historical mechanical wear or tissue loss.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced secondary notch or 'chip' on the left lobe trailing edge approximately one-third of the distance from the median notch to the tip.
